content: service method GetSwClusterChangeInfo [SWS_UCM_00356] Upstream: RS_UCM_00011 , RS_UCM_00018 GetSwClusterChangeInfo (OUT SwClusterInfoVectorType swInfo) This method returns a list pending changes to the set of SoftwareClusters on the adaptive platform. The returned list includes all SoftwareClusters that are to be added, updated or removed. The list of changes is extended in the course of processing Software Packages. Scope service interface PackageManagement class mono Fire & Forget false class mono Version 1.0 class mono Parameter th Name th Richtung th Typ th Beschreibung td swInfo td OUT td SwClusterInfoVectorType td List of SoftwareClusters that are in state kAdded,kUpdating or kRemoved.
